ns2:course.label: Graduate Seminar in Special Topics
ns2:course.description: Lectures and discussions on current research and literature on advanced topics in electrical engineering. 0 to 1 graduate hours. No professional credit. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 1 hour in the same semester to a maximum of 4 credit hours in separate semesters, if topics vary. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
